notes.title: Announcement on the display bug of the portal in the fifth chapter
notes.notes:
A small number of players have discrepancies between the display effect of the fifth level portal and the original effect. This bug does not affect the game process, but will greatly reduce the playing experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/69e3e4458d252fadd8c2a0c675c3dcd777d09fe4.png[/img]

After several days of hard work, the production team has located the cause of this bug and found a preliminary solution.

Players with the above bug display effect need to be deleted manually:
All .ini files under \Users\(user name)\AppData\Local\HiddenDream\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor in the C drive or delete the folder directly and restart the game can fix this problem.

Since this display bug only appears in a small number of players, players who do not have display problems don‘t need to perform the above operations. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to players who have shown bugs. Please give us more time, and we will continue to work hard to optimize and improve the game "Hidden Dream".

Thank you again for your support of "Hidden Dreams"!

notes.title: The game of life: sauna and development
notes.notes:
This fortnight Chengdu is officially in sauna mode, living in Chengdu can even save you big money on sauna costs every year. Every mid-summer, the natural 360 degree deathless giant sauna allows people to detoxify effectively every day, and occasionally a wild wind and gathering rain does not cool much, but adds water for the next round of steaming.

1. Shattering and reading
The students in the studio continued their development by relying on the air conditioning and wrapping themselves in blankets in the cold temperatures of the office. The art students continued to optimise the tedious lighting, effects and materials, the planning students adapted the music and sound effects line by line, and the programming students improved the operation of each scene and fixed the bugs little by little. The new content is not much, but it is very complicated and complicated, so I would like to thank them for their hard work in the face of the tight schedule. So, when I was supervised by the players' QQ group today, I could answer with rare confidence: "I do my best!". .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/3a8d913304c77a706f424eac4802935577bd26c6.png[/img]
It still looks like serious work is being done (the picture shows a before-and-after comparison of some of the scenes in Chapter 5)

At this stage, the task facing the studio is starting to move from the surface to the point, and the daily discussions are becoming more and more detailed, with more time being spent on the finer details and polishing parts that were easily overlooked in the past. This is, of course, a time-consuming and labour-intensive task that we all have to work on together, so that even in the face of the summer discount season, we have no distractions (or time, to be precise).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/52427b077860b0f14c7c6b95f87070a1ba2b63fc.gif[/img]
Curator and art discussing how to implement the new transitional levels

2. Is the music ready yet?
We've had a breakthrough with the music we've been waiting for, and we finally have something that's basically in place. The music is far more complex than we thought it would be, and the overall music will be based on the completed game levels, as well as the fit of the individual chapters and the integrity of the chapters, so there is not a lot of time left for the music guy, but we are happy to give him a hard time, as much as the players are happy to push us.

3. soon, soon
This has been the standard phrase we used to use when facing players' soul-torture. The development cycle of "Hidden Dreams" is quite long, and it can be called a miracle that it has survived so far. The result is now a maverick greeting group. The good thing is that even though it is such an uninteresting group of players, many of the old players have stayed in the group for two or three years and have never left, so whenever we see them coming out to support the game again, we are actually happy and grateful. So even though it's difficult, we'll have to digest it ourselves. Almost there, thank you.

notes.title: Game life: full of vitality
notes.notes:
After the Dragon Boat Festival, game development has entered the final stage before launching, and the entire June will be pushed forward in a relatively tight development rhythm. We hope that "Tibetan Dream" can meet with friends during this summer vacation as scheduled, so the finishing work this month is particularly important.
The studio held a communication meeting before the festival to sort out the work schedule in June, and refined it to the weekly task arrangement. As a studio that has been lying flat for a long time, this can be regarded as a huge breakthrough. In the process of communication, I could vaguely feel that everyone's emotions were high. The efforts of the past few years are finally coming to fruition, and I can't help but look forward to it.
The most important point of the research and development work in June is to continue to optimize the overall performance of the game. Although there are still many difficulties, recently, with the cooperation of all students, the optimization problem can make a little progress or breakthrough every day. The established expectations are approaching step by step.
In addition to performance optimization, there are several things that need to be dealt with in the next month:
1. Optimization of typography puzzles
The typography puzzle is set at the foot of Maiji Mountain in Chapter 2. It is a puzzle solution that has gone through many twists and turns. It was even abandoned by the team because it could not find a satisfactory form of expression in the design level for a long time. In the early demo, it was retained due to the positive feedback from players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/88c8960c3a57bb205ab9b04ed6082c888cb0f3f7.jpg[/img]

2. The Beautification, Decoration and Merging of Partial Buildings in Chapter 5
The map in Chapter 5 climbs up the snow-capped mountains. There are a large number of building communities along the way, and the individual buildings are also relatively large, so the corresponding art work is heavy and heavy, so we put some buildings with complicated level design in the later stage when it is relatively stable. Beautify and decorate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/56e4f72ff174ec024d42800db5f31feefb607fc0.png[/img]

This time, it is mainly for decoration of a movable building. The building is divided into three floors, and each floor is equipped with different organs. The above picture shows the conceptual design of the first floor. Some areas of this building will also be linked with the previous chapters, and there are various jumps specially designed for the disabled party to help you spend more daily time, which is really exciting!

3. Music and sound effects
Many comrades in the official QQ group think that the students in the production team are very Buddha, so I don't blame them. After all, they have not had contact with our music partners, otherwise they should think that we are still quite curvy.
Fortunately, the long-awaited and long-awaited production of music and sound effects is finally coming to an end. The problem that everyone has long complained that the soundtrack and sound effects are too simple is finally expected to be changed. There are music and sound effects friends. The reason why the time cycle will be changed Pulling so long is actually because they have extremely high professional requirements for soundtracks. We believe that the final effect is worth looking forward to.

4. Other
In addition to the above-mentioned content, there are many other arrangements waiting for us to complete, such as the behind-the-scenes production list and thank you list, the lighting adjustment of some scenes, the adaptation of the little fox standby action, the replacement of the model, etc. . Thinking of this, I can't help but feel like another day full of vitality!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/02eb73adcc5b931d4d0dd0758effd7040b464c18.jpg[/img]

At the beginning of the month, I participated in the demo festival held by WeGame, and I was fortunate to receive good player reviews. This undoubtedly gave us some confidence. Thank you for your support and suggestions for "Hidden Dream". Let's make persistent efforts. I hope this summer can give us a lot of confidence. Have a nice experience everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/a05c8a8558fc1e1a8805e85c6bb2c622df6b31d6.png[/img]

notes.title: Game of Life: Platinum
notes.notes:
In recent times, the studio has been very busy, and the development of the game has entered a white hot countdown phase, with a kind of fire in the rhythm. Half a month of liver-bursting to come up with a decent full version of the game before June, we have started the internal tests one after another in the past two days, and everyone has been doing a good job of carrying forward the good qualities of Soul Game players, with evil operations and restless map running, making "Hidden Dreams" turn from an adventure puzzle to a game where everyone comes looking for a fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/d765eabf4d3f48ded18c41a31cb5fdb1ac563328.gif[/img]
Even a princess is inevitably caught up in life (screenshot from Chapter 1, Outside Chang'an)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/f7cff7a3d6d6dda7d778d401cf4fd422ec0ddbf1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/45e9735fe12685c1d7583568d4601a5d00fcbcf5.gif[/img]
The producer's mandate was for us to test the game until we puked, so some students even tested the levels repeatedly to the point of falling asleep, and it probably wouldn't be long before we were all able to do a blindfolded speedpass. One of the most dreaded phrases from the program students lately is "I've got a new problem here." It felt like he was on the verge of PTSD, but as a veteran psionicist, our programming students have always had excellent professional ethics when it comes to "suffering".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/808622d3ec202843183591eccaf12d40928bb2d4.gif[/img]
During the testing period, the programmer, planner and art students were all in the office to record all kinds of bugs, which made the studio very busy recently!
The completion of this version will mean that the main development of Hidden Dreams will be completed and players will have something to look forward to, so we won't have to think of any more reasons to dove.

With the help of our distribution partners, Hidden Dreams was lucky enough to be selected for the Indie-Craft 2022 event in Korea, and we will be bringing it to the BIG Festival in Brazil. From our previous participation in Steam's online exhibition Enter The Dragon, we were surprised to find that many foreign gamers also liked the theme and style of Hidden Dreams. We hope to have more exchanges with players from different regions before and after the game's launch, so that we can gain some new inspirations or experiences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/bb2f318745dd43148bfa0cbe60a04c1b1e4a293a.png[/img]
The biggest test of the overseas show was the producer's pure American country English
We are also looking forward to this year's offline exhibition. The more difficult it is, the more we hope to meet with you and encourage each other through the game, and we hope we will be able to communicate and learn from you this summer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/23bec7ad8cb86371bcd844075daa23d5c3bf38cf.gif[/img]
After repeated research, adaptation and adjustment, the new movements of the little Tibetan fox have become more and more flexible in the project, you can't quite feel it in the pictures, but I hope the little fox will be cute to you in the game afterwards~

notes.title: Devlog
notes.notes:
In the last two weeks, the studio has burst into development, mainly dealing with the following boards.
1. Adjustment of the terrain environment in Chapter 5.
The terrain materials in Chapter 5 have been enriched so that the terrain surfaces are no longer homogeneous and raw. The environment was then decorated and beautified by laying vegetation and decorating buildings and stacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/90960049e6a038ab2ac19323a09349091536cdb4.jpg[/img]
The screenshot shows one of the many terrain adjustments in Chapter 5, which is a more time-consuming and tedious project

2. Replacement of the title animation.
In the previous updates, you may have already had some idea of the game's title animation. At this stage, in addition to the subsequent adaptation of the music and animations, this title animation with independent artist Sakai Da has been completed and we have proceeded to replace the full title animation for the latest version of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/7a361673925c605cf52ffa24867a402d2d506f63.gif[/img]
This section of the animation is a foreshadowing of the scene in Chapter 5, where the view from the foothills of the mountain is of the snowy mountains to be crossed, in Tibetan "Gesang" means "good times" or "happiness".

3. Adapting the new series of moves
As a result of the workshop on the design of the moves in Chapter 6 (see: Game of Life: Pushing My Fox), the studio has adapted the main moves for Chapter 6, so for the past two weeks we have been going through a cycle of discussing, testing, solving doubts and adapting the new moves, with the aim of solving this long-standing problem as quickly as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/e07f18af7becbfc7e455a8b14620ba8146f0af00.gif[/img]
We also took the opportunity to optimise some of the characters' movements, with the intention of fixing some of the movement design problems that existed in the early stages with the princess and the fox. The art and programming students ate dozens of popsicles out of the studio fridge in order to make all the animations work smoothly. At the time of writing, they are walking back and forth more than 10,000 steps to each other to communicate about a new technical problem.

4. Performance optimization
Another fellow programmer in the studio, who is also our Chief Health Officer (yes, Tianfu Software Park requires every company to have this position), Dr. Huang, who eats junk food every day, has recently had a phase of improvement in his allergic rhinitis, and his sneezing has dropped a lot. This has certainly taken a lot out of him, and well, work does make you healthier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/808622d3ec202843183591eccaf12d40928bb2d4.gif[/img]
Trust me, this is not a posed shot, the studio really hasn't been slacking off lately

5. Improve the music sound effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/798778288fff795dfcbcb9036eb33fc03f47d91c.jpg[/img]
After the five-day holiday, it's summer, so we hope you've all been able to catch the tail end of spring and find your own holiday fun.

Thank you for your interest, and if you haven't experienced our Hidden Dreams yet, you can go ahead and download the free trial to take on the challenge.

notes.title: Devlog
notes.notes:
Recently, during the whole post-production work, the team had to take care of their duties on the one hand, and on the other hand, as the studio has been lacking the support of dedicated motion production staff, we also had to learn the relevant content on our own to make up for it, and at the same time, the game program optimization work being promoted has taken a lot of efforts to explore due to lack of experience.

The workshop team also discussed the movement design for Chapter 6, which was limited by the shortcomings of the movement and the problems with the initial attempts at the princess movement, resulting in a stiff and even comical movement of the subject in Chapter 6.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/39076b24ae9c955782292e4ed10455e4d4c03c2a.jpg[/img]
Recently, the planning students have also been debugging the level design, especially after one collective internal test, many of the puzzle settings have been improved accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/e09f3e4182f0d616d61c5b9ac97a4e2acfb41aa9.png[/img]
For the sake of consistency in art style, we intended to replace all the stone pillars in the game with the more culturally relevant Shidang, and replace the traditional Shidang images of dragons and tigers with the in-game  Fox. In addition to this, Ruru has written the story line of the Little Fox himself, which is intended to provide a narrative link between the chapters and hint at the next chapter's decryption elements. In this way, the fox becomes a true companion in the princess's dream quest, away from the objects, and to a certain extent reinforces the game's narrative weaknesses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/8582865eae7223a929f6b395b33155252fc0f3a7.png[/img]
The studio has been tweaking the lighting and shadows for each chapter for some time. The feel of the level scenes is getting closer to our expectations. The first phase of the level planning, which focused on cultural exploration, has come to an end, and we are now focusing on the art and lighting, in the hope that in the limited time we have, we will end up with a graphics style that is as special as possible.

notes.title: Devlog#11
notes.notes:
Recently, we have optimized the design of the character, and made new adjustments to the princess’s image, clothing, and accessories. We hope that the final image of the character can be more Tang-style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/faefc1c8c40aa671ed2d6a1acdd0fd126345b3dc.png[/img]

The original painting started from the dynasty where Princess Wencheng lived, and we read a lot of documents related to clothing in the Tang Dynasty, trying to fit the clothing system of the time as much as possible. Because the game itself has a lot of action scenes that need to jump, the decoration part has been simplified and reduced appropriately, and the floater is used to reflect the light posture of the characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/30f29453642e003c393660f0bafb4d4e15342be1.png[/img]

It took a long time for my colleagues to form the shape from the early stage to the final shape. The early princesses were relatively thin. But considering that the Tang Dynasty had the aesthetic characteristics of fat as beauty. Colleagues look for ways to plump up the image of the princess, but at the same time they don't want to overexpress the figure or posture. Therefore, we finally found inspiration on some of the pottery figurines of the maids of the Tang Dynasty. Using pottery figurines as a model, the figures gradually became round and lovely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/4a1c58833c6a29ad3132c37e6809a2281bf5f770.png[/img]

In terms of color matching, it has inherited the color matching of some old models. At the same time, we hope to have more eye-catching colors and recognition, which can remind people of traditional clothing colors and patterns.

notes.title: Devlog#10
notes.notes:
Recently, the studio focused on the design and production of the fifth chapter. After the homesickness and confusion in the fourth chapter of Riyue Mountain, starting from the fifth chapter, the princess resolutely embarked on the road to the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with more and more snow-capped mountain scenes, and more and more cultural elements will appear in this chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/d6480c8918e6e5c55c8b99f6364222a79e6de9a1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/33de18aaee6b9d28e1882633e48bfadac9a00e5d.png[/img]

The special feature of the level design in this chapter is that the princess will go through the various puzzle-solving elements that appeared in the previous four chapters in the process of crossing the snow mountain, and there will be new upgrades and changes. To talk about the theme of the elements in this chapter, we think it would be more appropriate to use the word "time and space". How to use the space-time elements to achieve the integration between puzzles is left to players to experience slowly in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/396541fcc39e5792e588c1b926f39ea09973bde3.png[/img]

With a grand map that exceeds the previous chapters, the puzzle-solving methods of Chapter 5 are enough and special enough. The design of the terrain also hides mystery, which will bring some cultural elements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/ac210cb3cf7e8317fd413d8ac4425be5d880ddad.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog#9
notes.notes:
"Hidden Dream: Overture" will finally meet you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/9850b79fbe22ca379ce0ae4b81fbac3213f7f7fe.png[/img]

"Hidden Dream: Overture" is actually the first chapter of "Hidden Dream" (plus the previously published Demo, which is the second half of the second chapter). The background of the story is that Princess Wencheng just left Chang'an and ready to set off to the west. This is the simplest chapter of all the chapters (the puzzle difficulty of "Hidden Dream" increases as the chapter progresses), the purpose is to let friends understand and familiarize with the operation and game mechanism of "Hidden Dream".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/07bd663a8aebee06b7f8e7d13ffc4350dc68dc68.png[/img]

In order to no longer stick to the story-oriented mode of traditional games of this kind, we have made a new attempt. Each chapter will have a different emotional theme. This requires players to slowly experience the scene, color, layout and other aspects. We always believe that the current players can experience the difference in atmosphere between chapters.

notes.title: Devlog#8
notes.notes:
The first chapter in the plan has also begun to be adjusted: the scene of the first chapter is set in the outskirts of Chang'an City, which will be a simple chapter that tends to teach, so that players will be familiar with the puzzle solving of "Hidden Dream".The logical style and core gameplay of game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/9ab7ef665f14f21aff0762d101bf63126e606c40.png[/img]

We made certain adjustments to the water area (we will also talk about this later), and then the vegetation in the scene was also added, the color and effect of the clouds and fog in the distance were optimized, and the model was also replaced.

The special effect of the ground lawn blowing in the wind has also been completed, the light and shadow effects are more realistic, and the cloud shadow effects similar to those on the lawn have also been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/4ad63b2deba6dde05c6d8b92ff63ddd43d3a63e8.png[/img]

In the design of the mountain, we hope to incorporate some traditional Chinese painting-style landscape tones, which is difficult to achieve and balance, so the overall color ratio is still being explored.

Because there are abundant Danxia landforms in both northern and southern Shanxi, we deliberately added some colorful Danxia landforms in the distance to create a dreamlike, ethereal and colorful feeling.

For the whole part, we are still thinking about how to coordinate and improve many of the above elements, and hope that our players will also like this design layout.

notes.title: Devlog#7
notes.notes:
We believe that many friends have already played the latest game Demo of "Hidden Dreams", but some friends do not know the situation of the previous version of the Demo, so we simply chose two point to talk：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37254235/bed2ebf4886e5a270aa9a2bcf0cc69b4b00e0f73.png[/img]

The new version adds more vines here, so that players can face the vines once they come, and then ignite the vines to start the follow-up. The little helper of the Tibetan fox that we said in the past has also joined in to help Sokoban. We also designed decals on the ground, which can guide the players to try to push the box to the decal position. This way, we can better understand the intent of the level design and reduce the jump to the upper level due to the location of the box.

After repeated discussions this week, the problem of wall design was solved. In the initial design of the wall, we tried to faithfully restore the structure of the Tibetan building, but after showing it in the game, we found that the layered transition was not natural enough. Secondly, because of the difference in the height of different walls, the transitional lines will not align well, which will affect the appearance. Therefore, we later learned from the wall in the game "Overwatch", and the final rendering effect needs to be continuously adjusted.

notes.title: Devlog#3
notes.notes:
This week, after repeated discussions and design revisions, an important scene in the new chapter was finally built. In order to adapt to the scene and create a sense of sacredness and grandeur, we did not use sand paintings or murals. The form is restored, but the ground painting is used. The difficulty lies in restoring the intricacy and complexity of the traditional painting, and at the same time matching it with the game style of "Hidden Dream". Although it took a lot of time to communicate and adjust, we still want to show the beautiful art of traditional painting to players to experience.
